drums.description: Funk rock drum break, The kit consists of a dry, high-tuned snare with a crisp snap, a punchy kick drum with a short decay, and closed hi-hats, The pattern features a syncopated kick drum rhythm that emphasizes the and of beat one and the and of beat two, while the hi-hats play consistent eighth notes with slight accents on the downbeats, A ghost note on the snare occurs just before the backbeat on four, The recording has a tight, dead room acoustic with minimal reverb and high-frequency clarity on the cymbals, 110 BPM, 4/4 time signature Publish

vocals.description: Funk rock, Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and double-stops, An electric bass guitar performs a slap-and-pop technique, locking with the kick drum on the downbeat and syncopating on the off-beats, The drum kit features a tight, dry snare sound and a consistent hi-hat pattern with occasional open accents, A Hammond organ provides sustained chords with a slow rotary speaker effect, The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor, The arrangement maintains a steady groove with minimal melodic variation, focusing on rhythmic interplay between the bass and guitar Publish
